init_called_by_unauthorized.meaning: BuilderWallet.init() was invoked by a caller that is not an authorized party

builder_admin_overwritten.meaning: the builderAdmin address storage was overwritten by the unauthorized init() call

attacker_holds_builder_admin.meaning: the attacker address occupies the builderAdmin role after the overwrite

assumptions: init() is externally callable by any address (no caller restriction), per init_lacks_access_control.
The builderAdmin role is stored in contract storage that init() writes, per attacker_calls_init.
The attacker is an arbitrary user distinct from any authorized party, per attacker entity role.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether init() had already been called or whether builderAdmin was previously set before the attacker's call, so the overwrite-vs-first-set distinction cannot be bound.
Report does not identify which party is the legitimate authorized setter of builderAdmin, so the authorization predicate is represented only as 'unauthorized caller'.

limitations: Only the admin_takeover impact is formalized; token drain and loss-of-funds impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.

The relation encodes the forbidden overwrite of builderAdmin by an unauthorized init() caller; the attacker_holds_builder_admin symbol is declared for downstream sweep linkage but not used in this claim's relation.
No numeric bounds are present in the report for this impact, so no divisibility or threshold predicates apply.
